## Nemotron Embed VL 1B v2 API

Nemotron Embed VL 1B v2 is an embedding model by NVIDIA, available on the Venice API as `text-embedding-nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Nemotron Embed VL 1B v2 is NVIDIA's open-weight embedding model from its Llama Nemotron family, trained for retrieval over visually rich documents such as reports, slides and scanned pages. Through the API it embeds text into 2,048-dimensional vectors.

### Nemotron Embed VL 1B v2 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text-embedding-nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2` | Standard | Private | $0.0125 / 1M tok |

### Nemotron Embed VL 1B v2 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | NVIDIA |
| Released | Apr 17, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Dimensions | 2,048 |
| Max input | 32K tokens |

### How to use the Nemotron Embed VL 1B v2 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/embeddings` with `"model": "text-embedding-nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "text-embedding-nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2",
    "input": "Private AI for everyone."
  }'
```
